logos.attribution: Herut; Jabotinsky Institute item 37941. Unaltered campaign roundel crop.
logos.inUseEvidence: Jabotinsky item 37941: official Herut victory rally poster, exact catalogue year 1961 (שנה נכונה), title and printed 2.8.61 meeting in Bat Yam before the 15 August election. White ח in a dark-blue circular badge flanks the party name. Cropped the right-hand roundel, clear of the archive watermark on the left; no redrawing, recolouring or watermark removal.
